name: Wyoming Wildlife and Natural Resource Trust habitat grants

funder.name: Wyoming Wildlife and Natural Resource Trust

summary: Grants from a Wyoming state trust for improving terrestrial and aquatic wildlife habitat, watershed enhancement and open-space conservation easements, open to nonprofits and governmental organisations. Applications are due twice a year.
reporting: Sponsors maintain projects and report on progress and completion; monitoring and reporting requirements vary by project and are set out in the application.

eligibility.rule: The project provides a public benefit
The project does not reintroduce native or non-native game or non-game species under the Endangered Species Act
The project does not seek fee simple acquisition of real property
The project does not purchase water rights
Not used to meet required mitigation; funds may only expand on it

calls.label: Twice-yearly funding cycle
calls.recurring: Application deadlines are March 1 and September 1 each year

status.quote: Application deadlines are March 1 and September 1 annually

recurring.quote: Application deadlines are March 1 and September 1 annually

applicant_types.quote: The Board may grant funds only to non-profit and governmental organizations

geography.quote: Conservation, maintenance, protection and development of wildlife resources, the environment, and Wyoming's natural resource heritage.

access.quote: Applicants for funding should use the form attached to these guidelines.

window.quote: Projects will be funded twice annually, with funds made available for approved projects in July and January.

reporting.quote: Sponsoring entities will have the responsibility to maintain projects, and to report on progress and completion.

effort.quote: Applicants for funding should use the form attached to these guidelines.
All applications submitted will be considered pre-proposals, will be reviewed by WWNRT staff and subsequently reported to the Board.
Projects selected for final consideration by the Board in any grant cycle will be reviewed on-site by a committee of WWNRT Board members prior to funding.

eligibility.quote: Projects are required to provide a public benefit.
No funds shall be made available for the reintroduction of any native or non-native game or non-game species pursuant to the Endangered Species Act.
No funds shall be disbursed for fee simple acquisition of real property.
No funds shall be disbursed to purchase water rights, and no water rights may be accepted as gift, transfer, bequest, or donation unless such water rights are attached to real property.

Trust fund monies may be used to expand on, but not meet required mitigation, preclude regulatory actions, or for voluntary actions with a primary purpose of enhancing wildlife habitat, the environment or natural resource values.

after_award.quote: Sponsoring entities will have the responsibility to maintain projects, and to report on progress and completion.

documents.quote: Electronic applications should be submitted as separate attachments as follows: a. Application b. Maps c. Letters of recommendation d. Other attachments, including cover letter
